comments.text: Greetings from Finland! Yeah, I don't regocnice my home country from this video. Last winter was guite warm in the south were I live in, and the snow is propably 2-3 months in south and 5-7 months in the north.Suicide ratings are going down as the government has taken steps towards the problem. Why are you comparing  us to Turkey all the time. Turkey is a muslim country, we are not. Education and school lunches are free, and education is the same level in every school. Teachers are highly trained and respected. School weeks are shorter than in most countries in the World. Healthcare is allmost free, like givin' birth and staying in hospital in a family room with father for three days is about 150€ all together. Public transportation is everywhere and it works. Homelessness is not an issue, everybody is taken care of by government. And people here can and do trust the government. Crimerates are low, and police are trained for 3 years, not 10 weeks like in Usa. Instead of 55 000 lakes, mentioned in the video, we have more than 180 000 lakes. And in the lakes and Baltic sea we have 188 000 islands. Forest is about 80% of the land. We are in top in the air guality in the World. Helsinki tap water comes from Päijänne lake and has won many competitions in guality and taste, beating even Perrier! Winter is of course darker, we are in the northern Europe, but in the summer we have Midnight sun. People are kind and willing to help tourists when asked. In cities 90% speak English. WELCOME TO FINLAND!
